dz: 新法兰西和第一民族之间的蒙特利尔大和平签署.
de: Great Peace of Montreal between New France and First Nations is signed.

te: Date traditionally ascribed to Dom Perignon's invention of champagne; it is not clear whether he actually invented cham…
dz: 日期传统上归结于多姆·佩里尼翁发明了香槟;目前尚不清楚他是否真正发明了香槟,然而他却被誉为一位创新者,他开发了用来完善花花酒的技术.
de: Date traditionally ascribed to Dom Perignon's invention of champagne; it is not clear whether he actually invented champagne, however he has been credited as an innovator who developed the techniques used to perfect sparkling wine.

t: 摩洛哥人击败了葡萄牙人,但摩洛哥国王Abd al-Malik和葡萄牙国王Sebastian都战…
te: The Moroccans defeat the Portuguese but both the Moroccan king Abd al-Malik and the Portuguese king Sebastian die. Ahma…
dz: Al Kasr al Kebir战役:摩洛哥人击败了葡萄牙人,但摩洛哥国王Abd al-Malik和葡萄牙国王Sebastian都战死. Ahmad al-Mansur追随Abd al-Malik出任摩洛哥苏丹,而Sebastian之死导致葡萄牙接班危机.
de: Battle of Al Kasr al Kebir: The Moroccans defeat the Portuguese but both the Moroccan king Abd al-Malik and the Portuguese king Sebastian die. Ahmad al-Mansur follows Abd al-Malik as sultan of Morocco while the death of Sebastian leads to a succession crisis in Portugal.

t: 詹姆斯·道格拉斯带领突袭了韦尔达莱并几乎杀死了英格兰的爱德华三世.
te: James Douglas leads a raid into Weardale and almost kills Edward III of England.
dz: 第一次苏格兰独立战争:詹姆斯·道格拉斯带领突袭了韦尔达莱并几乎杀死了英格兰的爱德华三世.
de: First War of Scottish Independence: James Douglas leads a raid into Weardale and almost kills Edward III of England.

te: The so-called Black Parliament at Scone tries William II de Soules and other nobles who had plotted against Robert I of…
dz: 斯克内的所谓"黑人议会"(Black Parliament at Scone)审判了威廉二世·德·苏莱斯等曾谋划苏格兰的罗伯特一世并打算将威廉置于苏格兰王位上的贵族.
de: The so-called Black Parliament at Scone tries William II de Soules and other nobles who had plotted against Robert I of Scotland and intended to place William on the Scottish throne.

t: 埃夫沙姆之战:爱德华王子的军队(未来的英格兰国王爱德华一世)击败了西蒙·德·蒙特福特所率领的叛…
te: Battle of Evesham: The army of Prince Edward (the future king Edward I of England) defeats the forces of rebellious bar…
dz: 第二次男爵之战:埃夫沙姆之战:爱德华王子的军队(未来的英格兰国王爱德华一世)击败了西蒙·德·蒙特福特所率领的叛逆男爵(英语:Simon de Montfort, 6th Earl of Leicester),杀死了德·蒙特福特和他的许多盟友.
de: Second Barons' War: Battle of Evesham: The army of Prince Edward (the future king Edward I of England) defeats the forces of rebellious barons led by Simon de Montfort, 6th Earl of Leicester, killing de Montfort and many of his allies.

dz: 高古里欧-苏伊会战:针对高古里欧(朝鲜语:Korean (Korean))入侵辽西,苏伊会战皇帝文帝命其幼子杨良(由同首相高相相助)在满洲雨季征服高古里欧,由中国军队和海军出击.
de: Goguryeo-Sui War: In response to a Goguryeo (Korean) incursion into Liaoxi, Emperor Wéndi of Sui orders his youngest son, Yang Liang (assisted by the co-prime minister Gao Jiong), to conquer Goguryeo during the Manchurian rainy season, with a Chinese army and navy.

t: 对盖乌斯·韦雷斯腐败案的审判开始,由马库斯·图利乌斯·西塞罗出任检察官并出名的演讲者昆图斯·霍…

dz: 对盖乌斯·韦雷斯腐败案的审判开始,由马库斯·图利乌斯·西塞罗出任检察官并出名的演讲者昆图斯·霍滕修斯出任辩护律师.
de: The trial against Gaius Verres for corruption is opened, with Marcus Tullius Cicero as prosecutor and renowned orator Quintus Hortensius as defending lawyer.
